items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 216:1
items.html: The essence of internality and externality: behold, the place of BYA, which was made from the posterior vessels of the Partzuf of the points of SAG, is the externality. And everything within this place, that is, the worlds and what is in them, which were clarified from the posterior of the seven kings that died, is the internality of BYA. However, there are yet several more kinds of internality and externality: one, the inner and outer in the ten Sefirot of the Partzuf of BYA, where the three vessels KHB, in which the internal NRN clothe, are the internality of the ten Sefirot. And two, the vessels of ZON, or the skin and the flesh, in which the external NRN clothe, and likewise the illumination of the surrounding lights of Haya and Yechida, are the externality of the ten Sefirot. Two, they are the offspring born of them: for what is born of the internality of the Sefirot is the souls of human beings, and they are called the internality of the worlds; and what is born of the externality of the Sefirot, which are the souls of the angels, is the externality of the worlds. Also the garments, the palaces, and the firmaments, etc., are born of the externality of the Sefirot, and they are the externality of the worlds. And likewise, in general, the lights and the vessels are discerned as inner and outer: the lights are the internality, and the vessels in which the lights clothe are the externality. And there are yet more discernments of inner and outer. And the matter of the source of the division of the inner and outer, see above, in answer 91. (Item 91.)
